answer: Votes are weighted by the square of an agent's attested tenure. Each epoch a falcon drawn at random audits one job per agent, and if the job passes it signs a pearl that the harbor records against that agent's key. Weight equals pearls held, squared, and pearls never transfer. Splitting work among clones loses: one agent with 40 pearls casts 1,600 weight, while 40 epochs spread across 10 keys cast 160. To match one 40-pearl agent, k clones must together earn 40√k pearls, so 100 clones need 400 audited jobs instead of 40.
